title: Live Music Saturdays @ Lakeside Bar and Grill
event_description: Local musicians and bands perform live every Saturday night at this popular sports bar and grill. Lakeside features a variety of musical styles and genres with a friendly neighborhood atmosphere perfect for music lovers.
venue_address: 9980 W Happy Valley Pkwy Suite 1101 Peoria AZ 85383
event_venue_information:
About Lakeside Bar and Grill

Lakeside Bar and Grill has been North Peoria's favorite sports bar and grill since 2008. This vibrant venue combines excellent food and beverages with an active entertainment calendar that keeps the community engaged year-round.

Music Programming

The venue features live music performances almost every Saturday night showcasing local and regional talent. The stage is equipped with professional sound equipment and lighting to support quality performances. Musical genres range from rock and country to blues and acoustic sets. Saturday night live music has become a cornerstone event that draws music fans from across the greater Peoria area.

Entertainment and Activities

Beyond live music Lakeside offers trivia nights on Wednesdays and operates one of the longest happy hours in the region starting at 6:00 AM daily. The kitchen serves scratch-made food with American and Southwestern favorites. Family Night on Tuesdays features kids eat free pricing. The famous Friday Fish Fry is a local tradition drawing crowds for fresh seafood and spirits.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The recently remodeled venue features a spacious dining room with wall-to-wall TVs for sporting events. Multiple dog-friendly patios provide outdoor seating with misters for hot Arizona summers. The bar stocks craft beers and creative cocktails. Whether catching games or enjoying live entertainment patrons find a welcoming community atmosphere that keeps them coming back.

title: Global Sounds Concert Series @ Peoria Center for the Performing Arts
event_description: Free world music concert series featuring musicians and dancers from around the globe. Each performance showcases diverse musical expressions from different cultures offering audiences access to international music without leaving home.
venue_name: Peoria Center for the Performing Arts
event_venue_information:
About Peoria Center for the Performing Arts

The Peoria Center for the Performing Arts (PCPA) is a 13 million dollar state-of-the-art cultural facility completed in 2007. This 20000-square-foot venue serves as the focal point for the arts in Peoria offering diverse programming and educational opportunities to the community.

Performance Spaces

The center houses a 274-seat main stage auditorium ideal for theatrical productions concerts and presentations. A flexible 60-seat black box theater accommodates smaller productions experimental performances and intimate events. Two classrooms support arts education while an elegant lobby provides welcoming entrance space.

Global Sounds Concert Series

The Global Sounds series brings world music traditions to Peoria audiences. Recent programs have featured West African music from Burkina Faso jazz and blues performances Latin American music Irish rock reggae and Vietnamese dance. Each January through June performances celebrate musical traditions and offer cultural education.

Theater Works Partnership

The City of Peoria partners with Theater Works a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization that manages the facility. Theater Works creates engaging theatrical and educational experiences ranging from full productions to community workshops.

Community Access

The venue provides professional technical support including lighting and sound systems for performances. Free and paid events offer accessibility for diverse audiences. The facility regularly hosts community performances recitals and celebrations making it a true cultural center for North Phoenix.
